The '''''Sorannan''-class Star Destroyer''' was a class of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]].

==History==
One such ship was the [[Rakehell (Sorannan-class)|''Rakehell'']], which was used as a weapons and engine-testbed and captured by the [[Yevetha]]. It was later recaptured by survivors of the Yevetha occupation and served the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]]. The ''Rakehell'' was destroyed at the [[Battle of Anx Minor]] in [[17 ABY/Legends|17 ABY]], when the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] used a weak spot to breach the ship's antimatter containment.
